description: Delete a player profile. The default profile ('Padrão') cannot be deleted. A profile with no videos is deleted directly. A profile WITH videos needs `strategy` — ask the user which one: 'keep' = each video keeps its current look (gets its own copy of the profile's settings); 'migrate' = the videos move to `target_profile_id`. Up to 5 videos are processed immediately; more are queued (status 'pending') and the profile disappears once all videos are moved. If any video fails, the profile is NOT deleted.

strategy.description: Required when the profile has videos: 'keep' (videos keep their look) or 'migrate' (videos move to target_profile_id)

target_profile_id.description: Profile that receives the videos — required with strategy 'migrate'

name: panda_delete_profile
title: Delete Profile
